primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The percentage of participants with vIGA-AD success at Week 4 is presented. The vIGA-AD is a static evaluation of qualitative overall AD severity with five severity grades (reported as score of 0 'clear' to 4 'severe' with higher scores indicating greater symptom severity. vIGA success was defined as score of 'clear' or 'almost clear' plus a 2-grade improvement from baseline.
